_: The map regions (agents/MAP.md §8.10): id, name, claim and the sign scene – read by scripts/region-signs.mjs (the welcome signs) and scripts/map-regions-seed.mjs (the pre-drawn covers, the seed migration). Names and claims to refine (owner).

regions.name: Dünenmeer Magenta
regions.scene: glowing dunes drifting from tangerine into hot magenta and turquoise, neon-pink salt pans, black rock ridges with glowing veins, a lone camel-like creature

regions.name: Hochland Regenbogen
regions.scene: golden steppe grass, rainbow-striped mountains like Vinicunca, turquoise lagoons, a llama

regions.name: Ewigschnee
regions.scene: glittering snowy peaks in electric cyan and lilac, frosted pines, a cosy wooden chalet, icicles hanging from the sign

regions.name: Schuppenwald
regions.scene: dense emerald jungle canopy, iridescent lizard scales, a gecko peeking over the sign, steaming electric-blue swamp pools

regions.name: Ödland Fracktal
regions.scene: cracked sulphur-yellow crust, rusty drilling rigs, oily rainbow pools, radioactive green glow; the sign bent and patched, still proud

regions.name: Juwelenarchipel
regions.scene: little islands made of opal, malachite, rose quartz and lapis in a candy-blue sea, a shell and pearls

regions.name: Erzberge
regions.scene: green lowlands rising into huge, grim, jagged snowy mountains, rust-red ore slopes, a mining pick and hammer crest, a small monastery clinging to a cliff
